LOOK: Members of Filipinos Do Not Yield (FDNY), Alyansa Bantay Kapayapaan at Demokrasya (ABKD), Liga Independencia ng Pilipinas, and the People’s Alliance for Democracy and Reforms (PADER) stage a protest outside the House of Representatives in Quezon City on Tuesday, April 14, coinciding with the House Committee on Justice hearing on the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte.

The groups urged lawmakers to push through with the impeachment, saying it is a legitimate constitutional tool for holding public officials accountable. | 📷: Grig C. Montegrande, Philippine Daily Inquirer
